notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature with power one or greater for each opponent you have.
The additional creatures can attack this turn.
Opponents are unable to block and kill creatures you control.
You have not created a token this turn.
description:
Declare the additional creatures as attackers, ensuring each creature is attacking a different opponent.
Adeline triggers, creating a token copy of Master of Cruelties due to Esix that is tapped and attacking each opponent.
When each Master of Cruelties is not blocked, they trigger, setting each opponent life total to one.
Deal combat damage with the additional creatures, causing each opponent to lose the game due to having zero or less life.
